$comment: Sections and tuning. Copy this file to sections.json and edit it, or run as-is to use these examples. Sections are yours to name: add, remove, or rename them and point your feeds and prompt at the ids you choose. All ranking and ingest knobs live here, not in code.

sections.title: Technology
sections.description: Software, hardware, the internet, and the companies building them.

sections.title: Science
sections.description: Research, space, health, and the natural world.

sections.title: World
sections.description: Politics, business, and events shaping the wider world.

ranking.$comment: score = source weight (decayed per link) plus a velocity boost, scaled by importance. Higher importanceFactorPerPoint widens the gap between a routine item and a big one. decayHalfLifeHours sets how fast a story fades.

ingest.$comment: maxItemAgeHours drops anything older than this at fetch time so history never backfills. maxItems caps how many raw items state retains. seenHashRetentionDays is how long a URL stays deduped and how long an idle cluster survives. feedTimeoutMs bounds each feed fetch.
